faq.q: Is this different from boosting posts?
faq.a: Yes. Boost Post is a shortcut with very few controls. Proper campaigns use objectives, audiences, testing and tracking, so you can see what each rupee brings back.
Yes. For lead based businesses we run lead campaigns and track every lead in a CRM inside our Desk, so nothing is lost between the ad and the call.
It depends on your goals and market. We will recommend a test budget first, then scale once we know what works.

faq.q: Do we own the ad accounts?
faq.a: Yes. Ad accounts and pixels stay in your name. We work inside them with access you give us.
